items.html: And it is known that the drop that develops and shapes the fetus is the aspect of the Hassadim and Gevurot mentioned above, and these are the matter of the letters, from which the fetus is formed. Also, the letters are always the aspect of the vessels, as is known. And these become vessels for AVI [Abba ve-Ima] in the aspect of the backs, as mentioned above, and it is these that came down and fell below together with the remainder of the Hassadim descending to shape the vessels of the fetus, which are the sum of the seven kings who died, included in ZON.
